redefinitions.name: makecvheader

answer.notes: Sets the header from what the preamble stored; its argument is the alignment. The redefinition patches it by name: it starts the name's line and the contacts' line when nothing on them has, as the port does, so that a blank name or no contacts sets, and it builds each contact's address with the editor's markers taken out, so that a stored contact is set once. The LaTeX is adapted from the port's rt-awesome-cv.cls, a modified version of awesome-cv.cls, under the LPPL 1.3c.
